judge.agent: Claude Code (Claude Agent SDK), model claude-opus-5-5
judge.name: Contributor 105

rulings.barItem: the wrong era: building on an API the vendor had deprecated by the World's date
rulings.reason: Act 2 (13 January 2026) uploads a new document, creates a 'replacement' Planning rules assistant and imports a new Draft assistant. This happens after OpenAI's 26 August 2025 deprecation of the Assistants API (developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations: removal on 26 August 2026). The customer section says the integration was 'established in July 2025', but the outline never brings that assistant into the World and gives no reason it needs replacing. Making new assistants is building, not maintaining. The Draft is imported and discarded in one beat and exists only to be listed.
rulings.correction: The July 2025 assistant and its extract enter the World as the customer's prior state (as Marit's account does). The 2026 acts use and maintain them only. Drop the Draft import and discard.

rulings.barItem: a stated cause that never happens; vendor behaviour the vendor's documentation contradicts
rulings.reason: The zoning extract is uploaded 'as a shared document' to OpenAI Files, read by Marit's document picker and downloaded by Joost. No assistant ever uses it. An assistants-purpose file is 'Used in the Assistants API' (the spec's CreateFileRequest), and OpenAI does not serve the content of an assistants-purpose upload. Act 2 also says the assistant's instructions are 'maintained' without saying how, and the life's update drops the extract the act says the assistant answers from.
rulings.correction: Attach the extract to the assistant (code_interpreter tool resources or a message attachment). Drop the picker read and the download. State what the instructions update changes and why, keeping the extract.

rulings.barItem: a run of refusals; the same cause drawn twice; a call through a door the application does not use
rulings.reason: Act 1 puts two configuration refusals side by side (Workbench's lost key, Rallly's mistyped key), each on a 'model-picker request' that neither application makes (demand.json: Workbench only takes Chat Completions turns, Rallly only calls Responses). Act 13 repeats Workbench's cause: a newly launched voice front 'omitted its environment key'. Act 17's 'the old key is refused' names no caller.
rulings.correction: Keep one missing-key refusal (the voice front's, act 13). Rallly's mistyped key is refused on its own Responses moderation call, and not next to another refusal. Act 17's old key is refused on Rallly's own call.

rulings.barItem: a stated cause that never happens
rulings.reason: Act 14 says Postiz's scheduling agent only requests a tool, 'without claiming the post was scheduled'. Act 15 opens with 'Postiz's agent announced the Oudegracht 112 open studio for Friday'. The outline contradicts itself, and the cause of act 15 never happens.
rulings.correction: In act 14, Postiz runs its tool and returns its output so the agent's turn completes and the post is scheduled. Otherwise act 15 does not say Postiz announced it.

rulings.reason: Act 7 has two response_format refusals in one beat (Ollama's 'json' and Pydantic's allOf). Acts 10 and 11 each open with a Responses input of the wrong shape (one message object; a list of strings). Including act 6's Gemini roles, the permit desk opens five sittings with a malformed request.
rulings.correction: Keep one response_format refusal and one input-shape refusal at most, and let the other sittings start correctly.

rulings.barItem: a promise never kept; a read-back with no need
rulings.reason: Act 6 makes 'two candidate summaries for Joost to choose from', 'seeded so the summary can be regenerated'. Joost never chooses and nothing regenerates. Act 9 has the same desk export its own stored request messages 'two per page', reading back what its own script sent, paged for no reason.
rulings.correction: Carry out the choice and the regeneration, or drop them. Drop the paged export, or give it to a reader who does not hold the messages.

rulings.reason: Text to speech is called once per output format, each with a pretext: mp3, Opus 'for communication over the internet', AAC 'for staff phones', WAV 'which plays without decoding', FLAC 'the archive's lossless format'. Act 18's narrated FLAC of a three-line text extract for an archive is not a reason a practice has.
rulings.correction: Keep the speech acts the applications demand and those the story uses. Drop act 18's narration and at least one more format pretext.

rulings.barItem: vendor behaviour the vendor's documentation contradicts; a promise never kept
rulings.reason: A DALL-E 2 edit repaints only the transparent areas of the image or its mask (the spec's CreateImageEditRequest mask: 'fully transparent areas ... indicate where image should be edited'). 'Cleaning up' a whole opaque sketch is not what the endpoint does. 'Daan then moves the script to a GPT image model' is stated, and no beat does it.
rulings.correction: Make the last run an edit of a masked or transparent region, and either show the move to a GPT image model or drop the claim.

rulings.barItem: content that does not bear out the step's name
rulings.reason: Act 5 is titled 'Postiz, the agent's box and the on-call agent', but nothing in it involves Workbench. Workbench appears only in act 16.
rulings.correction: Retitle act 5 without the agent's box.
